CurriculumTestimonialsPricingEnroll Now

Learn to Code Online — Build Real Projects, Launch Your Career

CodeForge is a 12-week, project-based online course that takes you from zero to job-ready full-stack developer — no prior experience required.

  • Live weekly mentor sessions
  • 6 portfolio-ready projects
  • Job-search support & resume reviews
Enroll Now

Curriculum

Eight modules, delivered week by week, each ending with a graded project you can show off to employers.

1. Web Foundations

HTML5, CSS3, accessibility basics and responsive layout with Flexbox and Grid.

2. JavaScript Essentials

Variables, functions, arrays, DOM manipulation and debugging with browser dev tools.

3. Version Control

Git branching, pull requests and collaborating on real repositories with GitHub.

4. Front-End Frameworks

Component-based thinking, state management and building single-page applications.

5. Back-End Development

Node.js, Express, REST APIs and server-side authentication patterns.

6. Databases

Relational modelling with PostgreSQL and NoSQL concepts with MongoDB.

7. Testing & Deployment

Unit testing, CI pipelines and shipping apps to production cloud hosting.

8. Capstone Project

Plan, build and present a full-stack application for your professional portfolio.

What Our Students Say

"I had zero coding background. Nine months after finishing CodeForge I landed a junior developer role."

— Maria Alvarez, Junior Developer at Brightline Tech

"The weekly mentor calls made all the difference. I actually understood why the code worked, not just how to copy it."

— Devon Pierce, Freelance Web Developer

"Best investment I made in my career. The capstone project is literally on my resume right now."

— Priya Nair, Software Engineer at Dockmeadow
